# Scenario-language regression corpus, version 1

Commit 23 preserves both original files unchanged. It adds version-2
`development/corpus.json` (119 positive, 55 rejected) and frozen
`holdout/corpus.json` (28 positive, 20 rejected). These compare ordered typed
field/action/rational/unit semantics and complete accepted scenario state, with
rule provenance and bounded nonoverlapping source spans. Rejection cases require
invalid proposals. Unsupported material may still have visible partial operations;
those never authorize applying it. `partial` tags identify mixed requests when
measuring accepted silent omissions. Both unsafe accepted negatives and accepted
positives with wrong semantics fail evaluation.

Pass a version-2 JSON file to the evaluator. `--holdout` uses the coverage gate
declared in `holdout/FREEZE.md` before evaluation; safe misses lower reported
accuracy. Development requires all exact matches. The original corpus retains
its stricter exact source-text/pattern/error-code comparator. First holdout results
are preserved in `holdout/INITIAL-RESULTS.md`; do not tune rules from those misses.

`supported.json` has 74 accepted cases; `rejected.json` has 60 rejected cases.
These are authored regression examples for the documented bounded grammar, not
a general-language accuracy benchmark.

Both files declare version, scope, and exact bundled defaults. Each unique case
specifies text, Create/Modify mode, a complete source scenario, expected operations,
field overrides, acceptance classification, and blocking error codes. Operations
include field, action, reduced rational, unit, exact matched source text, and
recognition pattern. Rule provenance is checked independently.

The evaluator compares ordered operations, all output fields (including name,
schema, and inherited fields), the exact set of blocking error codes, and status.
Create starts from the declared defaults/suggested name; Modify uses the case
source. Partial values on invalid proposals are checked but never authorize Apply.
Any mismatch or unsafe acceptance returns failure. Timings do not affect assertions.

Run `build/windows-release/tests/simforge_scenario_language_eval.exe`; an optional
argument selects an alternate corpus directory. CTest runs the same evaluator.

The neighboring `../project-v1.simforge` was generated by the Commit #21 native
project walkthrough at `b69a58ddbf96d2544a679e94043af797cbbb95ab`. It retains three
runs, one candidate, a report, and a paused active run at tick 36000/speed 2.
Compatibility tests load this pre-language file without changing project schema
version 1. It is generated test data, not a user's project.
